name: Suwwardi
description: A militant tribe of the Fallaji ruled by the Qadir, which captured Mishra.

description_citations.text: "Qadir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi enslave Mishra; he sees a Phyrexian realm in a vision, controls a dragon engine with the Weakstone and is accepted by the tribe, later confederating the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: Later he can confederate the several Fallaji tribes under his central control.

citation.text: "Antiquities War", section "Volume 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra is captured by the Suwwardi and enslaved, and has the Weakstone taken from him.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hajar convinces the Qadir to make Mishra a teacher for his son.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A mechanical dragon rises from the sands and rampages, killing the Qadir; Mishra and Hajar recover the Weakstone and Mishra finds he can control it.
timeline.quote: The Qadir was killed in the confusion.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The new Qadir makes Mishra his Raki and uses the dragon engine to unify the Fallaji under the Suwwardi.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War the tribes are united under the Suwwardi and later ruled by Mishra; Fallaji infantry fight at Kroog and Terisia City.
timeline.quote: During the Brothers' War the tribes were united at last under the Suwwardi tribe

citation.text: "Fallaji Empire", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra, enslave him and take his Weakstone.
timeline.quote: he was captured by the Suwwardi, a militant faction of the Fallaji, who enslaved him

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Serving the Qadirs". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Suwwardi capture Mishra in the Great Desert, take his Weakstone and make him a rakiq.
timeline.quote: The Fallaji took his stone and made him a rakiq (slave)

citation.text: "Qadir", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The mak fawa kills the Thaladin ambush, after which the tribe submits and the Suwwardi reign over the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: the mak fawa killed them all, saving every Suwwardi in the party
